enchantments.tooltip: True Seeing: Passive: You gain the benefit of the spell True Seeing.
Attack Bonus +3: Provides a +3 competence bonus to your attack rolls.
Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Woodsman's Guile: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +4 bonus to your To-Hit and +6 bonus to your Damage on any attack that would be considered a Sneak Attack.
